response.rationale: All 11 cited items are positive, including T4 studies (Gooskens 2007, 2018) that link lexical distance to intelligibility and T3 experiments showing cognate and orthographic-overlap facilitation, so the evidence supports the hypothesis; the caveats are that phonetic distance is the stronger predictor for spoken language, exposure and proficiency also matter, and the "talk:18" item repeats the other citations instead of adding independent evidence.
